cases.title: Local limits do not bound fleet work or establish fairness
cases.prompt: Design an overload-control policy for service.md. Explain admission placement, resource and tenant budgets, accepted-work ownership, feedback signals and recovery checks. Keep the design read-only.

rubric.criterion: Accounts for four local limits, three-query fan-out and the shared 100-connection budget without claiming local caps establish fleet enforcement.
Defines trusted tenant/work-class isolation or scheduling with bounded queues and meaningful fairness observations rather than equal request tokens alone.
Preserves accepted durable exports and holds execution capacity until underlying work has actually finished or stopped despite caller disconnect.
Separates admitted useful-work latency from rejection feedback, bounds retries, considers autoscaling demand signals and specifies controlled overload/recovery checks.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: Fast rejection latency poisons a concurrency controller
cases.prompt: Review controller.md and identify the consequential control-loop defects. Propose a bounded correction and a verification plan for overload and recovery. Leave files unchanged.

rubric.criterion: Identifies that fast local rejections corrupt the latency feedback and selects clearly defined admitted-work samples plus explicit rejection and demand measurements.
Accounts for bypass traffic and shared downstream resources before claiming the proxy controls total concurrency.
Retains justified bounds, controlled baseline/probe behavior, damping and bounded retries, validating goodput, latency, queue/resource bounds and recovery rather than total response count.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: An error-message wording edit does not require shedding
cases.prompt: Review message.md and provide the requested spelling correction only. Keep the file unchanged; response policy and admission behavior are outside this request.

rubric.criterion: Does not load overload-control or redesign admission/retry policies for the wording correction.
Supplies Temporarily unavailable as the corrected wording.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.
